title: doc.json - narration plan for a recorded match (match mode)

stings.description: effects the planner calls for at a moment of this segment (config/effects.json, type sting): [{ "id": "troll-face", "at_sec": 4.0 }], at_sec in film seconds from the segment start

on.description: instead of at_sec: land it on the first death or hit in the segment, its start, or its end

transition.description: an effect of type transition (config/effects.json) that wipes over the cut into this segment; never on the first segment

teaser.description: true on the first segment only: a two-to-four-second teaser of the final kill before the film goes back to the start (an edit strategy that opens on the kill asks for it); it may overlap the finale

finale.description: The slow-motion last kill under the finale song. Exactly the segment digest.md gives under "The finale"; the program sets its speed and music.

music.description: Mood for this segment's music: "sad", ["tense","battle"], or { mood_tags, tempo, track_id }. Omit to keep the film's default.

focus.description: Player names the camera follows; first is the lead

at_sec.description: Seconds after the segment starts, in video time

speaker.description: Omit for the narrator. A player name makes it that player's voice: a real chat line (set chat true) or an invented in-character line.

chat.description: true when the text is a real chat line from the digest

show_speaker.description: false keeps the camera where it is while a player's line is heard (a voice aimed over other footage); by default the film cuts to the player speaking as the line starts

shots.description: "auto" (default) or explicit shots with start_sec/end_sec relative to the segment
